attrs.evidence: κ is defined on DIRECTED graphs via the largest SCC. Constraint edges are symmetric, so every orientation is arbitrary. CE-D: sites {a≠b, b≠d} and {a=c, c≠d}, oriented a→b, a→c, b→d, c→d — all SCCs trivial, κ = 0, and fidelity fails on the undirected split 4-cycle underneath.
attrs.statement: κ as defined in cell 01 carries the federation obstruction of cell 36.
